We need DBE for C8H15O3Cl. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (halogens count as H). O ignored. For halogen, treat as H. So effective H = H + halogen count = 15 +1 =16. No N. DBE = C - (H_eff)/2 +1 = 8 - 16/2 +1 = 8 -8 +1 =1. So DBE =1.

We should maybe retrieve formula via tool to be safe. Use retrieve_dbe_formula.
